LanguageData.NR_NodeTip_Core: Your digital trace: level, decay, what each level brings.
LanguageData.NR_NodeTip_Archive: The trace journal: everything that raised or lowered your Heat.
LanguageData.NR_NodeTip_Server: The colony's AIs: on the server, in coprocessors and in hosts.
LanguageData.NR_NodeTip_Studio: Braindance: raw recordings, the chip library and dependency. Exotic goods traders buy chips.
LanguageData.NR_NodeTip_Gateway: The way into cyberspace: pick an external node and dive from a cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_StatusEventTip: Latest trace event. Click to open the Archive.
LanguageData.NR_CoreAlertMercs: Trace at Target: mercenary raids possible
LanguageData.NR_HeatScreenNoFixer: Scrub at a fixer: no fixer is answering right now
LanguageData.NR_HeatScreenNetsickTip: Cyberspace dependency of colonists who dive a lot. It grows with time in the pod and Black ICE hits.
LanguageData.NR_TipTrace: Digital trace (Heat), 0-100. Hacks raise it, it cools over time; a fixer can scrub it.
LanguageData.NR_TipNet: Whether a powered network console is on the map. Without it the terminal works only from a cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_TipPod: Dives need a colonist with a cyberlink lying in a powered cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_BadgeBoard: Active contracts: {0}. Red: one ends within a day.
LanguageData.NR_BadgeArchive: New trace events since you last opened the Archive: {0}
LanguageData.NR_BadgeServer: AIs that need attention (request, hunger, escape): {0}. Red: one is escaping.
LanguageData.NR_BadgeStudio: Raw recordings waiting to be edited: {0}
LanguageData.NR_CoreAlertCounterHack: Turrets hijacked: counter-hack node in the Gateway
LanguageData.NR_CoreTileCyberdataTip: Cyberdata in the colony: dives, scrubs, programs. The small number is advanced cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_CoreTileAITip: Awakened AIs and the main AI server's slots.
LanguageData.NR_CoreTileChipsTip: Braindance chips in the colony; the small number is black chips.
LanguageData.NR_CoreRowNetTip: Power drawn by the network: console, cyberpods, coprocessors, servers. Online = a powered network console.
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingIntro: The node map, Heat and alerts will appear here. Go through these steps to start; the rest opens by itself.
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingStep_Console: Build a comms console: it becomes the network console
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingStep_FirstHack: Hack any target on the map and get your first cyberdata
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingContact: First contact: the Club opens as soon as there is Heat
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingNoteProtected: Until the colony is online, Netrun events do not come (newcomer protection).
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingNoteOpen: The colony is already online: Netrun events can come.
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingSkipTip: Show the full Core right away with every node open.
LanguageData.NR_OnboardingDone: Netrun: the colony is online. The Core opens node by node.
LanguageData.NR_NodeLocked_Club: Opens with the first Heat (the first hack).
LanguageData.NR_NodeLocked_Board: Opens after the first call to a fixer in the Club.
LanguageData.NR_NodeLocked_Archive: Opens with the first trace event.
LanguageData.NR_NodeLocked_Server: Opens when you have an AI fragment, an AI server or an AI.
LanguageData.NR_NodeLocked_Studio: Opens when you have braindance goggles, a recording or a chip.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2NoHistory: The graph fills in as you play.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2EffectScrub: Best scrub now: {0} Heat per cyberdata ({1}).
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2ViaFixerDesc: A fixer erases trace for cyberdata. You have {0} (+{1} advanced). Call to open a channel, then scrub.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2ScrubWithTip: The channel with {0} is open: choose how much cyberdata to hand over.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2CallFixerTip: Pay silver to open a channel with {0} for {1} hours, then the scrub window opens.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2GhostNone: Needs a Ghost AI on the server or in a host.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2GhostDesc: Its service wipes −{0} Heat for {1} trust.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2WaitDesc: −{0} a day (−{1} at Target and above)
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2AdviceHigh: lie low or scrub: Heat cools only −{0} a day now.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2AdviceNear: scrub the trace below {0} before "{1}" comes.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2AdviceOk: the trace is under control, {0} to zero.
LanguageData.NR_HeatV2AdviceClean: no trace. A good time for a dive.
LanguageData.NR_GuideButtonTip: Screen guide: areas light up, click one for a short walkthrough.
LanguageData.NR_HelpLeaveTip: Back to the screen you came from (Esc)
LanguageData.NR_HelpLocked: Opens when you meet it in the game.
LanguageData.NR_ArchiveInset: Heat over 7 days. Click a day to filter the journal, the wheel steps through days.
LanguageData.NR_ArchivePick: Pick a line to see the details.
LanguageData.NR_ArchiveHeatThenTip: The Heat graph and what changes it.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_LOBBY: The lobby: where every dive starts. Leaving from here is free.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_GATE: A code gate: a wall to hack before you can go on. Stronger nodes have stronger gates.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_FILES: Files: download them for the haul. They pay back the dive with a multiplier.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_HIDDEN: A hidden step: invisible until scanned. Not everything hidden is good to take.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_BLACKICE: Black ICE: strikes on every node turn while you are in the node. Shields, decoys and killers help.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_MEMORY: Memory units: may hold AI fragments or core modules.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveStepDesc_EXIT: The I/O port: leave with everything you found. A clean exit can bring a special find.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDiveSchemaHint: A node is a path of steps. Hover a step to see what it is, click to pin the text here.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDemoNeeded: Cyberdata to reach zero from here: {0} (a fixer without discounts).
LanguageData.NR_HelpDemoSick_Noticeable: Noticeable (30%+): after a day offline the mood drops, reality feels flat.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDemoSick_Strong: Strong (60%+): a little less consciousness, "net craving" breaks every few days.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDemoSick_Severe: Severe (85%+): worse mood and more frequent breaks.
LanguageData.NR_HelpDemoSickHint: Hover a stage to read what it does. The marker shows Netsick creeping up with daily dives.
LanguageData.NR_DeckGaugeHeat: Heat gauge: how hot your trace is.
LanguageData.NR_DeckTuner: The tuner: its mark jumps on every new event in the net.
LanguageData.NR_DeckLightNet: Net: lit while the colony is online.
LanguageData.NR_DeckLightSick: Netsick: blinks while a colonist has it.
LanguageData.NR_DeckLightPod: Pod: lit while a netrunner lies in a cyberpod.
